summary: Template: Private upgrade change request (required approvals/evidence)
description:
Goal: Standardize the change record for enterprise Private upgrades. We currently have inconsistent checklists across teams.

Deliverable: Create an internal-support Jira template issue (cloneable) called "Private Upgrade Change Request" with required fields and checkboxes for: change owner, customer approver, window, rollback plan, preflight evidence, SRE review, Security sign-off (when required), and customer comms.

Acceptance criteria:
- Template enforces required links to relevant Confluence policies
- Template includes explicit GO/NO-GO at window start
- Template includes post-window verification window and all-clear comms

References:
- Confluence: Production Change Management Policy
- Confluence: Private Deployments: Upgrade Go/No-Go Checklist (Enterprise)
- Confluence: Planned Maintenance Communications SOP (Enterprise)
- Confluence: Planned Change: SLO / Error Budget Impact Review Requirements
- Confluence: Secure SDLC: Security Sign-off for Customer Deployments
comments:
Camila Reyes: Drafted the template with sections: Summary; Scope; Risk level; Approvals; Preflight evidence; Monitoring; Rollback; Comms. Added required link fields (cannot close without them).
Grace O'Connor: Please add an explicit checkbox for "Error budget checked OR risk acceptance attached".
Camila Reyes: Added under SRE Review.
Naomi Feldman: Add a trigger section: "Does this change touch auth/RBAC/audit/TLS/deps?" If yes, security sign-off required.
Camila Reyes: Added a YES/NO question plus required approver field.
Laura Bennett: Looks good. Please ensure CS approval is required before sending the customer notice.
Camila Reyes: Added checkbox + CS approver field. Marking done.
resolution: Template created and made available as a cloneable internal-support issue type. Owners instructed to use it for all enterprise Private upgrade windows.
